title: A Boy And His Atom: The World's Smallest Movie
summary: IBM's record-setting stop-motion film made by moving individual carbon monoxide molecules with a scanning tunneling microscope, illustrating atomic-scale memory research.
why: Cited as a striking example of atom-level manipulation and STM imaging, including the ripples viewers ask about.

quote.text: This IBM video[1] was made with an STM scanning tunneling microscope, which sees outer electrons.
